jobs.prompt: Minimalist illustration on a pure black background, clean thin white line art with no shading, white lines only, no colour at all. People, animals and objects are drawn WHITE: white bodies, white clothes, white fills, never black-filled shapes or dark silhouettes. No text, letters or captions in the image. Vertical 9:16 composition. Scene: a big macro close-up filling the frame: a sad butterfly drawn in white line art sitting on a leaf. Its body is large, fat and swollen. Its wings are NOT open: they are tiny, crumpled, wrinkled, shrivelled little flaps no bigger than its head, drooping limp at its sides like crumpled paper. A broken empty cocoon hangs on the twig behind it. Clearly a butterfly that can never fly. No people.
